description: Shared scene-validation cases for the micro:bit channel contract. TypeScript (studio/web/tests/runtime.test.ts) and Python (studio/core.py) must accept every valid case and reject every invalid case. Each case is a complete minimal scene under 'scene'.

channels.led.X.Y: X column, Y row, each 0..4, origin top-left, value 0..255, only on behavior 'microbit'

contract.behavior: optional; only the value 'microbit'; only on an asset whose path ends in .glb
contract.non_finite_numbers: Python json.loads accepts the bare literals NaN, Infinity and -Infinity, which strict JSON (and JSON.parse) rejects. A Python validator must therefore reject non-finite numbers itself with math.isfinite, and treat bool as a non-number (true/false are not numbers). Those checks are covered by a Python unit test, not by this fixture.
contract.patternBindings: optional array of at most 100; object with exactly keys source,target,released,pressed; source in a|b|logo; target a microbit instance; (source,target) unique; released and pressed are 5 rows (y) of 5 columns (x) of finite numbers 0..255

valid.name: microbit scene with two pattern bindings and an LED track
microbit scene without tracks or pattern bindings
boundary values: LED 0 and 255, fractional grid values, a and logo tracks at 0 and 1
exactly 100 pattern bindings is allowed (34 microbit instances, distinct (source,target) pairs)
same source on two different microbit instances is allowed: uniqueness is on (source,target)
existing button and servo scene is unaffected

invalid.name: LED column 5 is out of range (led.5.0)
LED row 5 is out of range (led.0.5)
LED value 256 exceeds 255
LED value -1 is below 0
a value 2 exceeds 1
a track on an instance without behavior microbit
pressed track is button-only, not allowed on a microbit instance
angle track is servo-only, not allowed on a microbit instance
behavior microbit on a built-in asset
unknown behavior value
pattern grid with 4 rows
pattern grid with 4 columns
pattern grid value -1
pattern grid value 256
pattern grid value is a non-number string ("NaN"); strict JSON cannot encode non-finite numbers
pattern grid is not an array
pattern grid is an array but one row is not an array
pattern grid value is a boolean (true is not a number)
behavior is null, not absent
101 pattern bindings exceeds the limit of 100
pattern binding without pressed grid
pattern binding without released grid
pattern target is not a microbit instance (plain GLB)
pattern target is a built-in button
pattern target is an unknown instance
pattern source pressed is not a micro:bit channel
pattern source led.0.0 is not a momentary channel
duplicate (source, target) pattern binding
extra key on a pattern binding
patternBindings is not an array
